Running hard toward the NHK Mile Cup, El 
Condor Pasa had a major concern weighing 
on her mind.

Namely, that "she had no rivals running in 
the same race." She yearned for peers with 
whom she could push herself and grow 
together.

Grasping at straws, they invite King Halo 
to run in the NHK Mile Cup, only to be 
flatly rejected for making such an absurd 
request.

Seeing that, the Trainer wished that she 
could experience competing against a 
rival, even just once.
